div.div: غَرِيزَةٌ Nature: or natural, native, innate, or original, disposition, temper, or other quality or property; idiosynerasy; [of the measure فَعِيلَةٌ in the sense of the measure مَفْعُولَةٌ; as though signifying a disposition, &c., implanted by the Creator;] syn. طَبِيعَةٌ, (Lh, S, Msb, K,) and قَرِيحَةٌ, (S,) and سَجِيَّةٌ, (TA.) and أَصْلٌ; (Lh, TA;) whether good or bad; as, for instance, courage, and cowardice: pl. غَرَائِزُ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
